result: Design addendum: M6 (two pre-built R+X pages, one mremap swap behind a pagemap guard) replaces M4. Probes show M4's mprotect-to-exec refused (EACCES) under PR_SET_MDWE and systemd MemoryDenyWriteExecute; M6 works under all probed policies, static and PIE, Linux 6.8 and 7.0
head: e774f024

gate.affected: design only (no code); cargo xtask static rc=0

rulings.item: Swap a read+exec text page at start-up with mremap (M6, no write, no exec gain)
4 system calls and +2 VMAs per process on the AVX2 class
rulings.recommendation: accept unless CLASSED-SLOT-INFRA's start-up row measures worse
keep SSE2 (always correct; avoids the debugger-breakpoint crash)

rulings.item: Diagnostics: perf annotate/core files show SSE2 bytes; uprobes on the exported symbol miss after the swap

informational: gdb: a breakpoint set before run is lost at a start-up page swap, and a later stop writes the stale byte into the moved page (SIGSEGV); affects M4 and M6; the pagemap guard prevents it (probed)
systemd 255 applies MemoryDenyWriteExecute= through PR_SET_MDWE in the user manager (PR_GET_MDWE=1, Seccomp 0)
SELinux execmod, seccomp-form MDWE (<6.3) and PaX: documented only, UNTESTED; root-only SELinux command in doc 5.2
improvement: jobrun on a busy host queues a 1-minute probe behind full gates (45 min on one host); a small-job lane (e.g. kind=probe at 1 core) would let design probes run on a second host without waiting
next_step: Rule on the four items, then cut CLASSED-SLOT-INFRA (doc section 4 story 1) with the debugging note
